senses.gloss:
(इर) कुशिर r. 4th cl. (कुश्यति)
1 To embrace, to enfold.
2 To take out or from.
(इः) कुशि r. 1st and 10th cl. (कुंशति कुंशयति)
To shine: see कुस.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
1 Wicked, depraved.
2 Mad, inebriate.
mn. (-शः-श)
A species of grass used in many solemn and religious observances, hence called sacrificial grass, (Poa cynosuroides.)
m. (-शः)
1 The yoke of a plough.
2 A proper name, one of the sons of RĀMA.
3 One of the great Dvīpas or divisions of the universe, surrounded by the sea of spirituous liquor.
f. (-शा)
1 A rope.
2 A plant, commonly Maükāṭha.
n. (-शं)
Water.
(-शी)
1 A ploughshare.
2 Wrought iron.
mf. (-शः-शी)
A bridle, a horse's head rope.
E.
कु the earth, शीङ्^1 to sleep or rest, and ड affix, or कु bad, and शो to destroy, again कुश to embrace or to enfold, and क aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 315-320.

r. 9th cl. (कुष्णाति)
1 To expel, to force or draw out, to extract
2 To test, to assay.
3 To shine.
With अव,
to prove, to display;
with निर्,
to extract.

(इर) कुसिर r. 4th cl. (कुस्यति)
To embrace.
(इ) कुसि r. 1st and 10th cls. (कुंसति कुंसयति)
1 To shine.
2 To talk.

m. (-मा)
A camel.

m. (-यः)
A drinking vessel, a cup, a goblet.
E.
कुश to extract, and अय Uṇādi aff.

n. (-ष्पं)
A perfume, commonly Ganṭhiāla.

mfn. (-लः-ला or -ली-लं)
1 Happy, well, right.
2 Expert, skilful.
3 Clever.
4 Eloquent.
n. (-लं)
1 Adequacy, ability.
2 Virtue, virtuous action.
3 Well-being, happiness.
E.
कु the earth, and शल to go, affix अच्; also कुषल and कुसल.

mfn. (-लः-ला or -ली-लं)
Clever, expert, skilful: see कुशल.

adv. n. (-लं)
Well, happy, &c. see कुशल.

f. (-ता)
1 Cleverness, ability.
2 Eloquence.
3 Wellbeing.
E.
तल् added to the last; also with त्व, कुशलत्वं.

m. (-श्नः)
Salutation, greeting, friendly inquiry respecting a person's health or welfare.
E.
कुशल well-being, and प्रश्न asking.

du. m. (-वौ)
The two sons of RĀMA, or KUŚA and LAVA.

m. (-वः)
A bundle of Kuśa grass.
E.
कुश, and स्तव a cluster.

mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि)
Wise, able, intelligent.
E.
कुशल, and बुद्धि understanding.

mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि)
1 Auspicious, favourable.
2 Virtuous, good.
3 Happy, prosperous.
4 Clever.
E.
कुशल, and इनि aff.

n. (-रि)
Water in which Kusa grass has been boiled.
E.
कुश, and वारि water.

nf. (-लं-ली)
The country of Kanyakubja or Kanouj.
f. (-ली)
The residence of KṚṢṆA: see द्वारका.
2 A name of Oujein or Avanti during the Tretā Yuga or second age.
E.
कुश sacred grass, and स्थल place; abounding in Kuśa grass.

m. (-रः)
Fire.
E.
कुश the grass, &c. आकर a mine; the sacrificial fire being made upon a tuft of this grass.

m. (-क्षः)
A monkey, an ape.

mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं)
Sharp, shrewd, intelligent.
m. (-ग्रं)
The sharp point of the Kusa grass.
E.
कुश, and अग्र point.

mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि)
Sharp, shrewd, intelligent.
f. (-द्धिः)
Shrewdness, subtlety.
E.
कुशाग्र, and बुद्धि understanding; also similar compounds, कुशाग्रधी, कुशाग्रीयमति, &c.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Subtile, penetrating: see the next.
E.
कुश the grass, अग्र point, and छ, affix; implying resemblance.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Inspecting minutely, subtile, sharp sighted, intelligent, possessing mental acumen.
E.
कुश the grass, अग्रीय point, and मति mind; also other similar compounds, as कुशाग्रीयधी, कुशाग्रीयबुद्धि, &c.

n. (-यं)
A ring of Kusa grass, worn at religious ceremonies.
E.
कुश, and अङ्गुरीय a ring; also कुशाङ्गुरीयकं.

m. (-लिः)
A tree, (Andersonia rohitaka.)
E.
कु, and शाल्मलि silk cotton tree.

m. (-णिः)
The name of a sage celebrated for his irascibility: see दुर्व्वास.
E.
कुश the grass, and अरणि wood whose attrition produces fire; using Kusa for this purpose.

n. (-नं)
A seat of Kuśa grass.
E.
कुश, and आसन a seat.

f. (-पा)
A kind of Sisu tree, (Dalbergia Sisu).
E.
कु inferior, and शिंशपा the Sisu tree.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Squint-eyed.
m. (-कः)
1 A Muni or divine sage so named, the father of JAMADAGNI.
2 A ploughshare.
3 The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.)
4 Beleric myrobalan: see विभीतक.
5 The sediment of oil.
E.
कुश the grass, &c. इकन् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Mixed, combined with water, &c.
E.
कुश or कुष to embrace, to mix, and इतच् Uṇādi affix; hence also कुषित.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Mixed with water, &c. see कुशित.
n. (-त)
Happy, well, right, fortunate, auspicious, &c.

m. (-तः)
An inhabited country.
E.
कुस to shine, and इत Uṇādi aff.

m. (-शी)
A name of VĀLMĪKI, the author of the Rāmāyaṇa.
E.
कुश the son of RĀMA, affix इनि; the poem is supposed to be recited by KUSA and LAVA, the sons of the hero.

n. (-दं)
1 The profession of usury.
2 Red saunders: see कुमीद.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Indifferent, apathetic, inert.
n. (-दं)
Usury: see कुसीद.
E.
कु vile, षद to move, &c. अच् aff.

n. (-दं)
1 Usury, the profession of usury.
2 Any loan or thing lent to be repaid with interest.
mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
1 A money-lender.
2 Slothful, inert.
E.
कुस to embrace, ईद Uṇādi affix; or कु bad, and षद to go, affix अच्.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Ill-behaved. rude, wicked.
2 Evil disposed, ill-tempered.
E.
कु, and शील temper, conduct.

f. (-ता)
1 Misbehaviour, misconduct.
2 Bad disposition, ill-temper.
E.
तल् added to the preceding; also with त्व, कुशीलत्वं.

n. (-वः)
1 An actor, a dancer, a mime.
2 A bard, a herald.
3 A newsmonger.
E.
कु bad, शील practice, and वः affix, from वा to go, &c. with क affix, du. m. (-वौ) The two sons of RĀMA: see कुशलव.

m. (-शः)
A name of VĀLMĪKI: see कुशिन्.

m. (-लः)
A granary, a cupboard, a place in which rice or other grain is kept.
2 Conflagration of chaff.
E.
कुश to enfold, कूल affix; also कुसूल.

m. (-लः)
A granary, &c. see कुशूल.

m. (-न्यः)
Grain stored for three year's consumption.
E.
कुशूल, and धान्य grain.

m. (-कः)
A householder, &c. who has three year's grain in store.
E.
कुशूलधान्य, and कन् aff.

n. (-यं)
A lotus in general.
m. (-यः)
1 A tree, commonly Kaniyār: see कर्णिकार.
2 The Indian crane.
E.
कुश water, in the seventh case, शीङ्^1 to sleep or rest, with the affix अच्.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 315-320.

m. (-रः)
The sun.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Having, or being covered with grass.
E.
कुश and उत्तर beyond.

n. (-कं)
Water in which Kusa grass has been infused.
E.
कुश, and उदक water.

mfn. (-कुः-कुः-कु)
1 Burning, scorching, inflaming.
2 Wicked, detestable.
m. (-कुः)
1 A monkey.
2 The sun.
3 Fire.
E.
कुष to shine, काकु Uṇādi affix; also कुषाकु.

ind.
Excellently.

n. (-ष्ठं)
1 Leprosy, of which eighteen varieties are enumerated, seven great or severe, and eleven of minor importance.
2 A plant, a kind of costus, (Costus speciosus.)
3 A sort of poison.
E.
कुष to extract, and क्थन् Uṇādi affix, or कु bad, ill, and स्थ being, staying.

m. (-घ्नः)
A medicinal plant, commonly Hiyāvali: see हितावली.
f. (-घ्नी)
1 An esculent root, (Solanum Indicum.) see काकमाची.
2 Opposite leaved fig tree; also काकोडुम्बरिका.
E.
कुष्ठ the leprosy, and घ्न what destroys.

m. (-नः)
1 White mustard.
2 A sort of yam: see वाराही.
E.
कुष्ठ the leprosy, and नाशन what destroys.

f. (-नी)
A plant, commonly Hākuca, (Psoralia corylifolia.)
E.
as above: see कुष्ठनाशन.

n. (-लं)
1 A bad place or spot.
2 The surface of the earth.
E.
कु bad, or the earth, and स्थल place; स becomes ष, and थ is then changed to ठ.

m. (-नः)
The cassia tree, (C. fistula.)
E.
कुष्ठ, and सूदन destroying.

m. (-हृत्)
Catechu, (Mimosa catechu): see खदिर.
E.
कुष्ठ leprosy, and हृत् what takes away, from हृ to convey, affix क्विप्.

m. (-न्ता)
A large esculent root, described as possessed of medicinal virtue in leprosy, and other cutaneous affections, (Arum campanulatum): see हस्तिकन्द.
E.
कुष्ठ leprosy, and हन्तृ what kills or destroys.

m. (-रिः)
1 A fetid mimosa, (M. Farnesiana.)
2 The Khayar or Catechu: (M. catechu.)
3 A kind of Aristolochia: see अर्कपत्र.
4 A sort of gourd, (Trichosanthes dioeca.)
5 Sulphur.
E.
कुष्ठ the leprosy, and अरि an enemy.

mfn. (-ष्ठी-ष्ठिनी-ष्ठि)
Leprous, a leper, &c.
E.
कुष्ठ, and इनि aff.

n. (-लं)
Cutting, dividing.
E.
कुष to extract, and क्मलन् Uṇādi aff.

mf. (-ण्डः-ण्डा or -ण्डी)
A pumpkin gourd, (Cucurbita pepo).
m. (-ण्डः)
1 One of a class of demigods attached to ŚIVA.
2 State of the womb in gestation.
f. (-ण्डी)
1 A name of DURGĀ.
2 A drug.
3 A religious ceremony, a certain rite performed as a penance or expiation; also कुष्माण्डक.

mf. (-ण्डः-ण्डी)
A pumpkin gourd, (Cucurbita pepo.)
m. (-ण्डः)
A kind of sprite or imp, of which there exists a Gaṇa or class.
f. (-ण्डी)
A name of DURGĀ; also कुम्माण्ड and कूष्माण्डक.

m. (-कः)
A pumpkin gourd, (Cucurbita pepo.)
E.
कु the earth, उष्म heat, अन् to exist or be, ड affix, and the vowel irregularly short, कन् added; also कुष्माण्ड.

m. (-कः)
A pumpkin gourd: see कूष्माण्ड.
E.
कु bad, उष्म warm, and अण्ड an egg, here put for seed, कन् aff.

f. (-रित्)
A shallow stream.
E.
कु bad, सरित् a river.

f. (-यी)
The wife of a money-lender: see कुसीदायी.

m. (-थः)
Usury, usurious interest, any exceeding five per cent.
E.
कुसीद, and पथ for पथिन् road.

f. (-द्धिः)
Interest on money.
E.
कुसीद, and वृद्धि increase.

f. (-यी)
The wife of a usurer.
E.
कुसीद a usurer, ऐ substituted for its final, and ङीष् affix; also कुसीतायी.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
One who follows the profession of usury.
E.
कुसीद usury, and ठक् aff.

n. (-मं)
1 A flower in general.
2 Fruit.
3 The menstrual discharge.
4 Ophthalmia, disease of the eyes.
E.
कुस to shine, उम Uṇādi aff.

m. (-कः)
KĀMA.
E.
कुसुम, and कार्म्मुक a bow.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Heaped with flowers.
E.
कुसुम, and चित gathered.

n. (-रं)
A city, the vicinity of the modern Patna: see पाटलिपुत्र.
E.
कुसुम a flower, and पुर a city.

n. (-ध्यं)
The name of a tree, bearing a large acid fruit, (Dilenia Indica.)
E.
कुसुम a flower, and मध्य the centre; the flower blossoming from the fruit.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Producing flowers, causing to flower.
E.
कुसुम nom. verb, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
In flower, flowering.
f. (-ती)
1 A female during menstruation.
2 A town: see कुसुमपुर.
E.
कुसुम and मतुप् aff.

m. (-कः)
A collection of flowers, a garland, a nosegay.
E.
कुसुम, and लवक a cluster.

m. (-रः)
1 Spring, the vernal season.
2 A quantity of flowers or place abounding with them, a parterre, a garden.
E.
कुसुम, and आकर a mine.

n. (-नं)
The calx of brass, used as a collyrium.
E.
कुसुम a flower, and अञ्जन application to the eyes; resembling a flower.

n. (-कं)
Saffron.
E.
कुसुम, and आत्मक self; the essential part of the flower.

m. (-पः)
The Campa, a tree which bears a yellow fragrant flower, (Michelia champaca.)
E.
कुसुम a flower, and अधिप a king; royal amongst flowers.

m. (-राट्)
See the preceding.

m. (-धः)
A name of KĀMADEVA.
E.
कुसुम a flower, and आयुध a weapon: his shafts being tipped with flowers.

m. (-लः)
A thief.

m. (-यः)
Gathering flowers.
E.
कुसुम, and अवचाय, gathering.

n. (-कं)
A chaplet, a crown of flowers.
E.
कुसुम, and अवतंसक a tiara.

n. (-वं)
Honey.
E.
कुसुम, and आसव spirit.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Flowered, budded, in flower.
E.
कुसुम, and इतच् aff.

f. (-ता)
A species of the Dhṛti metre.

m. (-षुः)
A name of the god KĀMA.
n. (-षु)
The bow of KĀMA.
E.
कुसुम, and इषु an arrow; whose shafts are flowers.

n. (-म्भं)
1 Safflower, (Carthamus tinctorius.)
2 Gold.
m. (-म्भः)
The water pot of the student and Sannyāsī.
E.
कुस to shine, and उम्भः Uṇādi aff.

m. (-सूः)
An earthworm.
E.
कु the earth, सू produced.

f. (-तिः)
1 Wickedness, depravity.
2 Conjuring, slight-ofhand, &c.
E.
कु vile, सृ to go, क्तिन् aff.

m. (-भः)
A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
कु the earth, ष्टुभ to stop, क aff.

f. (-री)
A pungent seed used in condiments, coriander: see the next.

f. (-रुः)
Coriander, a pungent seed.
E.
कु bad, vile, तुवि to take, उरु affix, deriv. irr.; also कुस्तुम्बरी.

m. (-प्नः)
A bad dream, nightmare.
E.
कु, and स्वप्न a vision.

r. 10th cl. (कुस्मयति)
1 To smile improperly or blamably.
2 To see mentally, to perceive, to imagine: this is considered by some as a denominative, and to be classed improperly amongst the roots.
